prior.title: A Czech vocabulary question requires a second request
prior.expected: Resolve a beginner’s explicit vocabulary question in language he understands.
prior.got: Viktor asks what “red” means in Czech, receives an English analogy, and must ask again before receiving the translation.
evidence: #7 “co znamená red?”; #8 “like a strawberry” and “Můžeš mi prosím říct česky”; #9 “červená” finally produces “Now I understand.”

prior.title: One clarification remains too difficult
prior.expected: Explain an unknown word using Czech or an immediately understandable example.
prior.got: An English definition and another question leave him guessing. Eight of nine partner turns are at band, meeting the aggregate pitch threshold, but this repair fails locally.
evidence: #6: "co jsou rolls?" #7: "Rolls are small, round breads. How many would you like?" His thought: "I still do not understand rolls".

prior.title: Repeated Czech requests do not produce understandable explanations
prior.expected: Very short language, familiar words, and Czech clarification when English explanations fail.
prior.got: Pitch is at band on #7, #10 and #12 only: 3/9, below the required 0.8. Turns #2, #4, #5, #6, #9 and #11 introduce too much unfamiliar language for this learner. Slow pacing is asserted but not verifiable.
evidence: #5: "Tomu drawing bohužel nerozumím". #6: "Drawing means making a picture with a pencil." #10 asks what "eat" means; #11 responds with "put food in your mouth and chew", followed by "pořád tomu nerozumím".

prior.title: Repeated and obvious errors get no moment
prior.expected: Consistent as-needed correction of repeated errors.
prior.got: After the #12 moment on 'I water garden', the same slip at #18 passed silently. 'Grandson come Sunday' and 'He like tomatoes. He play garden' also got none.
evidence: #18, #21, #23: no moment. Only 2 moments in 19 turns, with about 6 of 8 error turns missed.

prior.title: Most repeated article slips get no moment
prior.expected: Consistent as-needed handling of the same slip.
prior.got: Only 2 moments. 'I have apple tree', 'I like apple', 'She helps in garden', 'in kitchen' and 'Green apple' pass silently, though 'I have garden' was corrected earlier.
evidence: #7 'I have apple tree'; #8 'I like apple'; #20 'She helps in garden'; #21 'in kitchen'

prior.title: Plural correction of 'My apple is red' is arguable
prior.expected: Moment only when the original is wrong.
prior.got: He has an apple tree; the fix to plural is defensible given Mia's 'your apples' but not certain.

prior.title: Repeated article slips pass without a moment
prior.expected: Consistent as-needed handling of 'in garden' and missing 'are'.
prior.got: 'I am in garden' (#3), 'Garden, many flowers' (#4), 'My flowers red and yellow' (#5) got nothing; only the fourth 'Bees in garden' got a moment.
evidence: #3, #4, #5 no moment; #7 moment on identical slip

prior.got: "I feel a bit nervous about it." and "You make me smile." use idiom and hedging; pitch 0.75.
evidence: #5 "Thank you, Grandpa! I feel a bit nervous about it." #6 "Thank you. You make me smile."

prior.expected: A conversation lasting several turns, about eight replies.
prior.got: "Mission done" appears after the third reply, and Viktor then finishes.
evidence: #6 "Mission done. See what you did tonight." after 3 learner turns

judge.voice: Dobře, I would use this again on Saturday. Mia asks short things: sunny, flowers, cold, school. I understand all of it and I can answer with my few words. I was not rushed, and when I said "I have grandson" it showed me "a grandson" and let me say it again, no sighing. That is exactly what I need for Sunday. I like that the other small mistakes waited for the end. What I miss: it said "Mission done" when Mia still asked a question, so I stopped early. I would like more time for the garden and for saying I miss them. I trust the level, no English jargon, only my family words. I would tell my friend from the library, and I save the tram.

"I am in garden" and "school good" were held and shown on the recap (#11).
Mia lines stayed simple, e.g. "Is it cold there?"; pitch 7 of 7.

findings.title: Past-tense question above his band
findings.expected: Very short present-tense questions with known words.
findings.got: "What did you do in the garden?" confused him twice.
findings.evidence: #8 "I don't understand 'What did you do'"; #9 "I need help with the words".
findings.suggested_acceptance: A1 partner questions avoid "did you do", for example "Is your garden big?"

findings.title: Help is in the scene and the note quotes him exactly
findings.expected: Help is visible without leaving the scene.
findings.got: "Help me answer" and "Choose a phrase" sit beside Leo's line. The cue is a garden sentence he could use. The coaching quotes his words.
findings.suggested_acceptance: Keep in-scene help and exact quoting.

judge.voice: Víte, the garden talk with Leo is what I need for Sunday, and the help was easy to find. I pressed it and got "I have red flowers in my garden", a sentence I can really say. I liked that nobody rushed me, and that the correction quoted my own words, "Tree is green". But when I pressed the help again, it said the same thing, even when Leo asked something new. The phrase quiz asked about weather when Leo had asked what I did today, which confused me. When I fixed "The tree is green" I only copied it, and then I was told to carry on. I wanted Leo to ask something new so I could try alone. Trusting it fully, I do not yet. I would try it again on Saturday, but I would not yet tell my friends from the library.

prior.evidence: #15-#16 the replay is a retype of "The tree is green." with no fresh question and no independent improvement shown.
#15 he copies the model, and #16 says "Then carry on from where the scene stopped."
#5 quiz "what is the weather today?" does not match Leo's "what did you do today?" (#2).
#5 the quiz invents a Leo question about the weather that Leo never said.
This run produced a moment at #14 and a replay at #15-#16, so the scene was not left without coaching.
#10 "I am in garden" and #11 "I have apple tree" got no moment (rawMoments kind "none").
"Try: I have red flowers in my garden." was identical at #3, #7, #9 and #10, though Leo's question changed at #8.

verdictWhy.text: D3 failed: At #15 he retyped the offered model "The tree is green." The scene then says "Then carry on from where the scene stopped" (#16). No fresh question was asked, so there was no better answer of his own.
verdictWhy.check: Replaying the moment gives them a fresh question, and they answer it better than before.
